description: Source code implementing SIP registration status retrieval and parsing for Asterisk using process execution and string parsing functions.

methods.name: cmd_sip_registration_result_read
methods.description: Reads output from a process file descriptor into a buffer, handling errors and buffer overflow.

methods.name: cmd_sip_registration_parse
methods.description: Parses SIP registration status from a buffer, matching registration ID and authentication info, and sets registration status.

methods.name: cmd_sip_registration_get
methods.description: Executes Asterisk command to get SIP registration info, reads and parses the output, and returns registration status.
